Faith has over sixty branches and modesty is one; the true Muslim spares Muslims harm from his tongue and hand, and good Islam is feeding people and greeting everyone.
None truly believes until he wishes for his brother what he wants for himself and loves the Prophet most; loving for Allah's sake and loving the Ansar mark faith.
Whoever holds Allah and His Messenger dearest, loves others only for Allah's sake and hates returning to disbelief as he hates the fire tastes the sweetness of faith.
The Prophet told Sa'd a man passed over in a distribution might be only a Muslim, not a believer, and said good Islam is feeding people and greeting everyone.
Heraclius told Abu Sufyan that the growth of the Prophet's followers and none leaving his religion are the way of true faith once its delight enters the heart.
Disbelief's source is in the east and pride among camel and horse owners, gentleness among sheep owners; belief is Yemenite, harshness among Rabi'a and Mudar where Satan's two horns appear.
The Abd al-Qais delegation of Rabi'a, cut off by Mudar's disbelievers, are told to believe in Allah, pray, pay Zakat, give a fifth of booty and avoid four vessels.
Pointing to Yemen the Prophet said faith is there; towards the East, among Rabi'a and Mudar, are harsh camel-herders heedless of religion, where the two sides of Satan's head appear.
At Itban's house, where the Prophet prayed, he told a man calling Malik a hypocrite that the Fire is forbidden to whoever sincerely testifies that none but Allah deserves worship.
Whoever says none has the right to be worshipped but Allah and dies believing it enters Paradise, even with illegal sexual intercourse and theft, the Prophet repeated to Abu Dharr.
A Muslim is one from whose tongue and hands Muslims are safe, and an emigrant is one who abandons what Allah has forbidden.
Umar said the Prophet was dearer to him than all but himself; told he must be dearer than his own self, Umar said he now was, and the Prophet approved.
An adulterer, a drinker, a thief and a robber watched by people are not believers while committing these acts.
An adulterer is not a believer while committing illegal intercourse, nor a thief while stealing.
Faith leaves the adulterer, thief, drinker and killer while sinning, as Ibn Abbas showed by parting clasped hands, but returns if he repents, for repentance stays open.
When a man called Malik bin Ad-Dukhshun a hypocrite, the Prophet said whoever meets Allah saying none is worshipped but Allah, for Allah's sake, will be saved from the Fire.
Faith's sweetness belongs to whoever holds Allah and His Messenger dearest, loves others only for Allah, and hates returning to disbelief as he hates being thrown into the Fire.
The Prophet told the Abd Al-Qais delegation that belief in Allah means testifying to Him and His Messenger, prayer, zakat and a fifth of booty, and forbade four drinking vessels.
The Prophet told the Abdul Qais delegation that belief in Allah means testifying to Him alone, praying, giving Zakat and the khumus, and forbade four vessels used for alcoholic drinks.
